subject.title: feat: expose message topics in the web app

question: Should ClickClack support topic-based filtering as a first-class web, HTTP, and TypeScript SDK channel-history feature, rather than leaving topics effectively API-only?
rationale: The patch is a coherent implementation of a new user-facing workflow, but choosing to publish and maintain that cross-surface contract is product direction rather than a mechanical defect fix.

options.title: Sponsor the topic workflow
options.body: Accept the additive topic filter and SDK/API contract, then merge after normal maintainer review.

options.title: Keep topics API-only for now
options.body: Defer the web and public pagination expansion until the product direction is explicitly prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the topic workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the additive topic filter and SDK/API contract, then merge after normal maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies no individual current-main owner, while the remaining blocker is a repository-level product contract decision.
